description: Flat metadata schema for individual urban air-sample records used for metagenomic profiling of airborne microbial communities and their relationship to environmental conditions and human activity.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual air-sample record.

project_id.descr: Identifier linking the sample to a broader project or study cohort.

site_name.descr: Human-readable name of the sampling location/site.

site_type.descr: Urban environment category, e.g. roadside, park, residential area, industrial zone, transit hub, downtown street canyon.

country.descr: Country where the sample was collected.

city.descr: City or municipality where the sample was collected.

district_or_neighborhood.descr: Local administrative area or neighborhood within the city, if applicable.

elevation_m.descr: Ground elevation at the sampling site in meters above sea level.

sampling_height_m.descr: Height above ground at which the air sample was collected, in meters.

sampling_time_local.descr: Local clock time when sampling started or was captured, in 24-hour format if available.

time_zone.descr: Time zone of the sampling location or recorded time, preferably IANA time zone or UTC offset.

time_of_day_category.descr: Categorical time-of-day label, e.g. morning, afternoon, evening, night.

weather_condition.descr: General weather condition during sampling, e.g. clear, cloudy, rainy, foggy, windy.

air_temperature_c.descr: Ambient air temperature during sampling in degrees Celsius.

relative_humidity_pct.descr: Relative humidity during sampling as a percentage (0-100).

wind_speed_m_s.descr: Wind speed during sampling in meters per second.

wind_direction_deg.descr: Wind direction in degrees from north (0-360).

precipitation_mm.descr: Precipitation during the sampling interval in millimeters, if measured.

barometric_pressure_hpa.descr: Atmospheric pressure during sampling in hectopascals.

particulate_matter_pm1_ug_m3.descr: Concentration of PM1 in micrograms per cubic meter, if measured.

particulate_matter_pm2_5_ug_m3.descr: Concentration of PM2.5 in micrograms per cubic meter, if measured.

particulate_matter_pm10_ug_m3.descr: Concentration of PM10 in micrograms per cubic meter, if measured.

pollution_index.descr: Any local pollution summary index used at the time of sampling, such as AQI or a study-specific index; specify the scale in accompanying documentation.

traffic_intensity.descr: Qualitative or semi-quantitative estimate of nearby human/vehicle activity during sampling, e.g. low, medium, high, rush_hour.

people_density.descr: Estimated human crowd density near the sampling location during collection, if assessed.

sampling_device.descr: Air sampling device or platform used, e.g. filter sampler, impinger, cyclone, high-volume air sampler.

sampler_model.descr: Manufacturer and model of the sampling instrument.

sampling_flow_rate_l_min.descr: Air flow rate through the sampler in liters per minute.

sampling_duration_min.descr: Duration of the air collection period in minutes.

sampled_air_volume_m3.descr: Total volume of air sampled in cubic meters.

filter_or_medium_type.descr: Type of collection medium, e.g. PTFE filter, polycarbonate filter, liquid impinger medium, gelatin filter.

filter_pore_size_um.descr: Pore size of the filter in micrometers, if applicable.

sample_storage_temperature_c.descr: Temperature at which the collected sample was stored prior to extraction, in degrees Celsius.

storage_duration_h.descr: Time between sample collection and nucleic acid extraction, in hours.

nucleic_acid_extraction_kit.descr: Extraction kit or protocol name used to isolate nucleic acids.

extraction_date.descr: Date on which nucleic acid extraction was performed.

extracted_nucleic_acid_type.descr: Type of nucleic acid extracted, e.g. DNA, RNA, total nucleic acid.

extracted_nucleic_acid_concentration_ng_.descr: Concentration of extracted nucleic acid in ng/µL.

extracted_nucleic_acid_yield_ng.descr: Total nucleic acid yield in nanograms.

library_prep_kit.descr: Library preparation kit or protocol used before sequencing.

library_insert_size_bp.descr: Average or target insert size in base pairs.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing instrument/platform used, e.g. Illumina NovaSeq, NextSeq, Oxford Nanopore.

sequencing_strategy.descr: Sequencing strategy, e.g. shotgun metagenomics, amplicon, paired-end, single-end.

read_length_bp.descr: Read length in base pairs for each read, if applicable.

sequencing_run_id.descr: Identifier for the sequencing run or lane.

raw_read_count.descr: Number of raw sequencing reads generated for the sample.

quality_filtered_read_count.descr: Number of reads remaining after quality filtering.

host_dna_fraction.descr: Estimated fraction of host or non-target DNA in the sequencing data, if calculated.

blank_control_used.descr: Indicates whether a field/lab blank or negative control was processed alongside the sample.

contamination_flag.descr: Indicates whether contamination was detected or suspected for this sample.

bioinformatic_pipeline.descr: Name and/or version of the bioinformatic pipeline used for processing the sequencing data.

taxonomic_assignment_method.descr: Method used for taxonomic profiling, e.g. Kraken2, MetaPhlAn, 16S classifier.

alpha_diversity_index.descr: Alpha diversity value computed for the sample, if available; specify index in documentation (e.g. Shannon).

notes.descr: Free-text notes about unusual conditions, deviations from protocol, or site-specific observations.
